set.body: Make the contract legible through plausible failures. Include crossvalidated correlation-distance refusal, negative-distance clipping as an explicit new view rather than silent cleanup, coherent/configuration accounting instead of a remove-univariate claim, cross-run versus cross-session identity change at equal fold count, and learned-metric leakage/provenance refusal. Acceptance: each case is a runnable public example with the attempted call, exact capability or identity reason, scientifically valid alternatives, and a test that prevents silent fallback.
set.title: Centralize an executable scientific failure gallery
